```{=html}
<style>
  :root {
    --paper: #f4f6f1;
    --paper-raised: #ffffff;
    --ink: #14231f;
    --ink-soft: #48584f;
    --line: #c9d3c8;
    --line-soft: #dde3d8;
    --accent-deep: #1f5c6e;
    --accent-deep-soft: #e4eef0;
    --accent-surface: #b5651d;
    --accent-surface-soft: #f7e9da;
    --accent-bloom: #55742f;
    --accent-bloom-soft: #e9efdd;
    --ruler: #9fb0a3;
    --shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(20,35,31,0.06), 0 6px 20px -8px rgba(20,35,31,0.18);
    color-scheme: light;
  }

  @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
    :root {
      --paper: #0e1613;
      --paper-raised: #141f1b;
      --ink: #e9efe9;
      --ink-soft: #a9b7ac;
      --line: #24352e;
      --line-soft: #1b2822;
      --accent-deep: #6bb8cc;
      --accent-deep-soft: #16292d;
      --accent-surface: #e0a866;
      --accent-surface-soft: #2b2013;
      --accent-bloom: #a7c97f;
      --accent-bloom-soft: #1e2717;
      --ruler: #3a4b42;
      --shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.3), 0 8px 24px -10px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
      color-scheme: dark;
    }
  }
  :root[data-theme="dark"] {
    --paper: #0e1613; --paper-raised: #141f1b; --ink: #e9efe9; --ink-soft: #a9b7ac;
    --line: #24352e; --line-soft: #1b2822; --accent-deep: #6bb8cc; --accent-deep-soft: #16292d;
    --accent-surface: #e0a866; --accent-surface-soft: #2b2013; --accent-bloom: #a7c97f;
    --accent-bloom-soft: #1e2717; --ruler: #3a4b42;
    --shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.3), 0 8px 24px -10px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
    color-scheme: dark;
  }
  :root[data-theme="light"] {
    --paper: #f4f6f1; --paper-raised: #ffffff; --ink: #14231f; --ink-soft: #48584f;
    --line: #c9d3c8; --line-soft: #dde3d8; --accent-deep: #1f5c6e; --accent-deep-soft: #e4eef0;
    --accent-surface: #b5651d; --accent-surface-soft: #f7e9da; --accent-bloom: #55742f;
    --accent-bloom-soft: #e9efdd; --ruler: #9fb0a3;
    --shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(20,35,31,0.06), 0 6px 20px -8px rgba(20,35,31,0.18);
    color-scheme: light;
  }

  * { box-sizing: border-box; }
  html, body { margin: 0; padding: 0; }
  body {
    background: var(--paper);
    color: var(--ink);
    font-family: -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif;
    font-size: 16px;
    line-height: 1.55;
    -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
  }
  .display {
    font-family: "Iowan Old Style", "Palatino Linotype", "Book Antiqua", Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif;
    text-wrap: balance;
  }
  code, .mono {
    font-family: ui-monospace, "SFMono-Regular", "Cascadia Mono", Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace;
    font-variant-ligatures: none;
  }

  a { color: var(--accent-deep); }

  .wrap { max-width: 960px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 3.5rem 1.5rem 6rem; }

  /* ---------- Header ---------- */
  header.intro { margin-bottom: 3rem; }
  .kicker {
    font-size: 0.72rem;
    letter-spacing: 0.12em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--accent-deep);
    font-weight: 600;
    margin: 0 0 0.6rem;
  }
  h1.display {
    font-size: clamp(1.9rem, 4vw, 2.6rem);
    font-weight: 500;
    margin: 0 0 0.8rem;
    letter-spacing: -0.01em;
  }
  header.intro p {
    max-width: 62ch;
    color: var(--ink-soft);
    font-size: 1.02rem;
    margin: 0 0 0.4rem;
  }
  header.intro .pkg {
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    color: var(--ink-soft);
    margin-top: 1.1rem;
  }
  header.intro .pkg code {
    background: var(--paper-raised);
    border: 1px solid var(--line);
    border-radius: 4px;
    padding: 0.12em 0.45em;
    color: var(--ink);
  }

  /* ---------- Legend ---------- */
  .legend {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 0.5rem 1.4rem;
    margin-top: 1.6rem;
    padding-top: 1.4rem;
    border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
  }
  .legend-item {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    font-size: 0.82rem;
    color: var(--ink-soft);
  }
  .swatch { width: 0.65rem; height: 0.65rem; border-radius: 2px; flex: none; }

  /* ---------- Profile / ruler layout ---------- */
  .profile {
    position: relative;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 3.2rem 1fr;
    column-gap: 0.4rem;
  }
  .ruler {
    position: relative;
    border-right: 1px solid var(--ruler);
  }
  .ruler::before {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    left: -1px; top: 0.5rem; bottom: 0.5rem;
    width: 1px;
  }
  .tick {
    position: absolute;
    right: -1px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.35rem;
    transform: translateY(-50%);
  }
  .tick .dot {
    width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%;
    background: var(--ruler);
    border: 2px solid var(--paper);
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--ruler);
  }
  .tick .depth {
    font-family: ui-monospace, "SFMono-Regular", Consolas, monospace;
    font-size: 0.68rem;
    color: var(--ink-soft);
    font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
    white-space: nowrap;
  }

  .stages { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0; }

  section.stage {
    position: relative;
    padding: 1.7rem 0 1.9rem 1.4rem;
    border-bottom: 1px dashed var(--line);
  }
  section.stage:last-child { border-bottom: none; }

  .stage-head {
    display: flex;
    align-items: baseline;
    gap: 0.75rem;
    margin-bottom: 0.3rem;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
  }
  .stage-name {
    font-family: "Iowan Old Style", "Palatino Linotype", Georgia, serif;
    font-size: 1.28rem;
    font-weight: 500;
    margin: 0;
    letter-spacing: -0.005em;
  }
  .stage-tag {
    font-size: 0.68rem;
    letter-spacing: 0.08em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    padding: 0.18em 0.55em;
    border-radius: 3px;
    font-weight: 600;
  }
  .stage-desc {
    color: var(--ink-soft);
    font-size: 0.92rem;
    max-width: 58ch;
    margin: 0.15rem 0 1.1rem;
  }

  .cards {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(15.5rem, 1fr));
    gap: 0.65rem;
  }

  .card {
    background: var(--paper-raised);
    border: 1px solid var(--line);
    border-radius: 7px;
    padding: 0.8rem 0.85rem 0.75rem;
    box-shadow: var(--shadow);
    transition: border-color 0.15s ease, transform 0.15s ease;
  }
  .card:hover, .card:focus-within { transform: translateY(-1px); }
  .card summary {
    cursor: pointer;
    list-style: none;
    display: flex;
    align-items: flex-start;
    justify-content: space-between;
    gap: 0.5rem;
  }
  .card summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; }
  .card .fn-name {
    font-size: 0.86rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: var(--ink);
    word-break: break-word;
  }
  .card .chev {
    flex: none;
    color: var(--ink-soft);
    font-size: 0.7rem;
    margin-top: 0.15rem;
    transition: transform 0.15s ease;
  }
  .card[open] .chev { transform: rotate(90deg); }
  .card .one-liner {
    font-size: 0.82rem;
    color: var(--ink-soft);
    margin: 0.35rem 0 0;
    line-height: 1.45;
  }
  .card .detail {
    margin-top: 0.6rem;
    padding-top: 0.6rem;
    border-top: 1px solid var(--line-soft);
    font-size: 0.8rem;
    color: var(--ink-soft);
    line-height: 1.5;
  }
  .card .detail b { color: var(--ink); font-weight: 600; }

  /* stage accent variants */
  .stage[data-tone="deep"]    .stage-tag { background: var(--accent-deep-soft); color: var(--accent-deep); }
  .stage[data-tone="surface"] .stage-tag { background: var(--accent-surface-soft); color: var(--accent-surface); }
  .stage[data-tone="bloom"]   .stage-tag { background: var(--accent-bloom-soft); color: var(--accent-bloom); }
  .stage[data-tone="deep"]    .card:hover { border-color: var(--accent-deep); }
  .stage[data-tone="surface"] .card:hover { border-color: var(--accent-surface); }
  .stage[data-tone="bloom"]   .card:hover { border-color: var(--accent-bloom); }

  /* under the hood */
  .hood {
    margin-top: 1rem;
    font-size: 0.8rem;
    color: var(--ink-soft);
    background: var(--paper);
    border: 1px dashed var(--line);
    border-radius: 6px;
    padding: 0.65rem 0.85rem;
  }
  .hood b { color: var(--ink); font-weight: 600; }
  .hood .mono { color: var(--ink); }

  footer.note {
    margin-top: 3rem;
    padding-top: 1.4rem;
    border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
    font-size: 0.82rem;
    color: var(--ink-soft);
  }
  footer.note code { color: var(--ink); }

  @media (max-width: 640px) {
    .wrap { padding: 2.2rem 1.1rem 4rem; }
    .profile { grid-template-columns: 1.6rem 1fr; }
    .tick .depth { display: none; }
    section.stage { padding-left: 1rem; }
  }

  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
    * { transition: none !important; animation: none !important; }
  }

  :focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-deep); outline-offset: 2px; }
</style>

<div class="wrap">

  <header class="intro">
    <p class="kicker">LakeEnsemblR.WQ &middot; package map</p>
    <h1 class="display">Where each function sits in the workflow</h1>
    <p>
      The package mirrors a lake profile: work starts at the surface with
      configuration, passes through the calibration layer where most of the
      complexity lives, and settles into comparison and visualization at the
      bottom. This map follows that order &mdash; each depth is one stage of
      the pipeline, each card is one exported function.
    </p>
    <p class="pkg">Companion to the <code>full-workflow</code> vignette &middot; read top to bottom for a first run-through</p>

    <div class="legend">
      <span class="legend-item"><span class="swatch" style="background:var(--accent-surface)"></span>Setup &amp; execution</span>
      <span class="legend-item"><span class="swatch" style="background:var(--accent-deep)"></span>Measurement &amp; calibration</span>
      <span class="legend-item"><span class="swatch" style="background:var(--accent-bloom)"></span>Analysis &amp; visualization</span>
      <span class="legend-item">Click a card for what it takes in / hands off</span>
    </div>
  </header>

  <div class="profile">
    <div class="ruler" id="ruler"><!-- ticks injected to align with stage tops --></div>

    <div class="stages" id="stages">

      <section class="stage" data-tone="surface" data-depth="0 m">
        <div class="stage-head">
          <h2 class="stage-name display">Configure</h2>
          <span class="stage-tag">stage 1</span>
        </div>
        <p class="stage-desc">Turn one master YAML into every coupled model's native config files.</p>
        <div class="cards">
          <details class="card">
            <summary><span class="fn-name mono">export_config_wq()</span><span class="chev">&#9654;</span></summary>
            <p class="one-liner">Distributes LakeEnsemblR_WQ.yaml settings &mdash; module activation, parameter defaults, coupling &mdash; into GLM/GOTM/Simstrat's own config files.</p>
            <p class="detail"><b>Takes in</b> LakeEnsemblR_WQ.yaml (+ LakeEnsemblR.yaml if converting).<br><b>Hands off</b> populated model folders, ready for <span class="mono">run_ensemble_wq()</span>.</p>
          </details>
          <details class="card">
            <summary><span class="fn-name mono">load_config()</span><span class="chev">&#9654;</span></summary>
            <p class="one-liner">Reads and validates an Output-style YAML &mdash; bathymetry, metric dictionary, model output folders &mdash; into resolved paths.</p>
            <p class="detail"><b>Takes in</b> Output.yaml.<br><b>Hands off</b> a config list used internally by nearly every function below.</p>
          </details>
        </div>
        <div class="hood">
          <b>Under the hood &mdash;</b> <span class="mono">export_config_wq()</span> calls
          <span class="mono">set_up_configs()</span>, <span class="mono">set_coupling()</span>,
          <span class="mono">export_inputs()</span>, <span class="mono">export_pclake_physics()</span>,
          and <span class="mono">convert_ler_to_lerwq()</span> for you &mdash; rarely called directly.
        </div>
      </section>

      <section class="stage" data-tone="surface" data-depth="4 m">
        <div class="stage-head">
          <h2 class="stage-name display">Validate</h2>
          <span class="stage-tag">stage 2</span>
        </div>
        <p class="stage-desc">Catch a broken config before spending minutes on a run that was always going to fail.</p>
        <div class="cards">
          <details class="card">
            <summary><span class="fn-name mono">validate_glm_aed()</span><span class="chev">&#9654;</span></summary>
            <p class="one-liner">Checks a GLM-AED2 folder's glm3.nml / aed2.nml for required sections.</p>
          </details>
          <details class="card">
            <summary><span class="fn-name mono">validate_gotm_wet()</span><span class="chev">&#9654;</span></summary>
            <p class="one-liner">Same check for GOTM-WET / GOTM-Selmaprotbas's gotm.yaml + fabm.yaml.</p>
          </details>
          <details class="card">
            <summary><span class="fn-name mono">validate_simstrat()</span><span class="chev">&#9654;</span></summary>
            <p class="one-liner">Same check for Simstrat-AED2's simstrat.par.</p>
          </details>
        </div>
        <div class="hood">Also runs automatically inside <span class="mono">run_ensemble_wq(validate = TRUE)</span> &mdash; call these directly only when you want failures surfaced earlier.</div>
      </section>

      <section class="stage" data-tone="surface" data-depth="9 m">
        <div class="stage-head">
          <h2 class="stage-name display">Run the ensemble</h2>
          <span class="stage-tag">stage 3</span>
        </div>
        <p class="stage-desc">Execute each coupled model through its own runner package.</p>
        <div class="cards">
          <details class="card">
            <summary><span class="fn-name mono">run_ensemble_wq()</span><span class="chev">&#9654;</span></summary>
            <p class="one-liner">Runs the requested models via GLM3r / WETr / SelmaprotbasR / SimstratR, skipping or stopping on failure per <span class="mono">on_error</span>.</p>
            <p class="detail"><b>Takes in</b> exported model folders.<br><b>Hands off</b> each model's <span class="mono">output.nc</span>, ready for metrics.</p>
          </details>
        </div>
      </section>

      <section class="stage" data-tone="deep" data-depth="14 m">
        <div class="stage-head">
          <h2 class="stage-name display">Measure</h2>
          <span class="stage-tag">stage 4</span>
        </div>
        <p class="stage-desc">Pull harmonized variables and standard limnological metrics out of each model's output.</p>
        <div class="cards">
          <details class="card">
            <summary><span class="fn-name mono">get_output_wq()</span><span class="chev">&#9654;</span></summary>
            <p class="one-liner">Reads output.nc and returns harmonized-unit variables at requested depths &mdash; the shared extraction engine behind calibration scoring and plotting.</p>
          </details>
          <details class="card">
            <summary><span class="fn-name mono">cal_metrics()</span><span class="chev">&#9654;</span></summary>
            <p class="one-liner">Computes every metric listed in Output.yaml, for one model or all of them.</p>
          </details>
          <details class="card">
            <summary><span class="fn-name mono">cal_stats()</span><span class="chev">&#9654;</span></summary>
            <p class="one-liner">NSE / RMSE / NRMSE / PBIAS / KGE between observed and predicted vectors &mdash; the scoring primitive used everywhere else.</p>
          </details>
          <details class="card">
            <summary><span class="fn-name mono">extract_variable_list()</span><span class="chev">&#9654;</span></summary>
            <p class="one-liner">Batch-extracts and caches variables across models for a metrics dictionary.</p>
          </details>
          <details class="card">
            <summary><span class="fn-name mono">integrate_depths()</span><span class="chev">&#9654;</span></summary>
            <p class="one-liner">Depth-integrates a profile variable into a single water-column value.</p>
          </details>
          <details class="card">
            <summary><span class="fn-name mono">create_netcdf_output() / create_netcdf_wq()</span><span class="chev">&#9654;</span></summary>
            <p class="one-liner">Builds harmonized NetCDF output from extracted variables.</p>
          </details>
          <details class="card">
            <summary><span class="fn-name mono">cal_epi_depth(), cal_meta_depth(), cal_strat_date() &hellip;</span><span class="chev">&#9654;</span></summary>
            <p class="one-liner">Metric-specific calculators (anoxic days, ice duration, stratification onset, DO exceedance, nitrification, temperature difference) referenced by the dictionary's <span class="mono">function_name</span> column.</p>
          </details>
        </div>
      </section>

      <section class="stage" data-tone="deep" data-depth="20 m">
        <div class="stage-head">
          <h2 class="stage-name display">Calibrate</h2>
          <span class="stage-tag">stage 5 &middot; core</span>
        </div>
        <p class="stage-desc">The deepest and busiest layer &mdash; sample parameters, edit configs, run, score, repeat, then commit the winner.</p>
        <div class="cards">
          <details class="card">
            <summary><span class="fn-name mono">create_calibration_tables()</span><span class="chev">&#9654;</span></summary>
            <p class="one-liner">Generates editable per-module calibration CSVs (bounds, include flags) from the parameter dictionary.</p>
            <p class="detail"><b>Hands off</b> CSVs you edit by hand &mdash; set <span class="mono">include = TRUE</span>, adjust bounds.</p>
          </details>
          <details class="card">
            <summary><span class="fn-name mono">calib_setup_from_tables()</span><span class="chev">&#9654;</span></summary>
            <p class="one-liner">Reads the edited CSVs into the <span class="mono">calib_setup</span> table every calibration function below consumes.</p>
          </details>
          <details class="card">
            <summary><span class="fn-name mono">run_lhc_wq()</span><span class="chev">&#9654;</span></summary>
            <p class="one-liner">Latin Hypercube sampling (+ optional DE refinement) for one model: edits config files, runs, scores against <span class="mono">obs_file</span>, restores originals on exit.</p>
            <p class="detail"><b>Takes in</b> <span class="mono">calib_setup</span>, observed CSV.<br><b>Hands off</b> a results table with <span class="mono">attr(., "best_parameter_set")</span>.</p>
          </details>
          <details class="card">
            <summary><span class="fn-name mono">run_lhc_wq_parallel()</span><span class="chev">&#9654;</span></summary>
            <p class="one-liner">Same sampling, distributed across worker processes.</p>
          </details>
          <details class="card">
            <summary><span class="fn-name mono">cali_ensemble_wq()</span><span class="chev">&#9654;</span></summary>
            <p class="one-liner">Multi-model wrapper &mdash; runs <span class="mono">run_lhc_wq()</span> per coupled model, sequentially or concurrently, one call.</p>
          </details>
          <details class="card">
            <summary><span class="fn-name mono">write_best_calib_to_par_files()</span><span class="chev">&#9654;</span></summary>
            <p class="one-liner">Writes the winning parameter set back &mdash; into par_file CSVs, or directly into model configs with <span class="mono">write_target = "config"</span>.</p>
            <p class="detail"><b>Takes in</b> LHC/DE results + <span class="mono">calib_setup</span>.<br><b>Hands off</b> an updated model config &mdash; re-run <span class="mono">run_ensemble_wq()</span> to see it take effect.</p>
          </details>
          <details class="card">
            <summary><span class="fn-name mono">set_value_config()</span><span class="chev">&#9654;</span></summary>
            <p class="one-liner">Writes one parameter value into a model's native config, resolved via the dictionary &mdash; the mechanism behind <span class="mono">write_target = "config"</span>.</p>
          </details>
        </div>
      </section>

      <section class="stage" data-tone="deep" data-depth="27 m">
        <div class="stage-head">
          <h2 class="stage-name display">Test sensitivity</h2>
          <span class="stage-tag">stage 6</span>
        </div>
        <p class="stage-desc">See which parameters actually move the outcome, before or after calibrating.</p>
        <div class="cards">
          <details class="card">
            <summary><span class="fn-name mono">run_sensitivity()</span><span class="chev">&#9654;</span></summary>
            <p class="one-liner">Sweeps a single parameter across its bounds and records the response.</p>
          </details>
          <details class="card">
            <summary><span class="fn-name mono">run_multi_param_sensitivity()</span><span class="chev">&#9654;</span></summary>
            <p class="one-liner">Same, across several parameters in one pass.</p>
          </details>
        </div>
      </section>

      <section class="stage" data-tone="bloom" data-depth="33 m">
        <div class="stage-head">
          <h2 class="stage-name display">Compare &amp; visualize</h2>
          <span class="stage-tag">stage 7</span>
        </div>
        <p class="stage-desc">Read whatever's currently sitting in output.nc against observations, or across models.</p>
        <div class="cards">
          <details class="card">
            <summary><span class="fn-name mono">plot_model_vs_obs_wq()</span><span class="chev">&#9654;</span></summary>
            <p class="one-liner">Plots one model's existing output against observed data at matching depths, KGE/RMSE per depth. Reads output.nc &mdash; doesn't run the model.</p>
          </details>
          <details class="card">
            <summary><span class="fn-name mono">compare_plot() / scat_plot()</span><span class="chev">&#9654;</span></summary>
            <p class="one-liner">Multi-model (GLM, WET, SELMAPROTBAS, Simstrat) comparison against observations, with stats annotated.</p>
          </details>
          <details class="card">
            <summary><span class="fn-name mono">compare_models_metric() / _netcdf()</span><span class="chev">&#9654;</span></summary>
            <p class="one-liner">Cross-model metric comparison tables and plots.</p>
          </details>
          <details class="card">
            <summary><span class="fn-name mono">plot_heatmap_wq()</span><span class="chev">&#9654;</span></summary>
            <p class="one-liner">Depth&ndash;time heatmap of a single variable.</p>
          </details>
          <details class="card">
            <summary><span class="fn-name mono">plot_anoxic_metrics(), plot_ice_metrics(), plot_strat_metrics()</span><span class="chev">&#9654;</span></summary>
            <p class="one-liner">Metric-specific comparison plots across years and models.</p>
          </details>
          <details class="card">

<script>
  // Position ruler ticks to align with each stage's top, and label with its depth.
  (function () {
    var ruler = document.getElementById('ruler');
    var stages = document.querySelectorAll('.stage');

    function place() {
      ruler.innerHTML = '';
      var base = document.getElementById('stages').getBoundingClientRect();
      stages.forEach(function (s) {
        var r = s.getBoundingClientRect();
        var top = r.top - base.top;
        var tick = document.createElement('div');
        tick.className = 'tick';
        tick.style.top = top + 'px';
        var dot = document.createElement('span');
        dot.className = 'dot';
        var depth = document.createElement('span');
        depth.className = 'depth';
        depth.textContent = s.getAttribute('data-depth');
        tick.appendChild(dot);
        tick.appendChild(depth);
        ruler.appendChild(tick);
      });
      ruler.style.height = document.getElementById('stages').offsetHeight + 'px';
    }
    place();
    window.addEventListener('resize', place);
    document.addEventListener('toggle', function () { setTimeout(place, 0); }, true);
    setTimeout(place, 200);
  })();
</script>
```
